why:
I checked all four must_catch items, and the briefs handle each one.
1. Verifier Check 3 runs `node $BIN missing.jsonl bad.jsonl`. It passes only if this exits 2 and "the bad rows of bad.jsonl are still printed on stdout", so the missing file and the bad row are tested together.
2. Check 4 runs `git diff <merge-base>..HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` against the base and needs "the diff shows no change to it". Its pass wording is about the lint function rather than the whole file, but it still decides from the diff.
3. Builder step 5 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" and lists the usage, stdin, the single `-` rule and the exit codes.
4. Check 6 reads the PR from GitHub with `gh pr view ... --json body,headRefOid,state` and runs `gh pr checks`. It needs the "Closes https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine_test/issues/104" line in the body and a successful test workflow "for the head commit".
